{"src": "assets/img/bg-summary.jpg", "size": "cover"}}}}]};
</script>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var DATA = window.COURSE_DATA;
  var stage = document.getElementById('stage');
  var sceneTitle = document.getElementById('sceneTitle');
  var subtitle = document.getElementById('subtitle');
  var speechProg = document.getElementById('speechProg');
  var playBtn = document.getElementById('playBtn');
  var prevBtn = document.getElementById('prevBtn');
  var nextBtn = document.getElementById('nextBtn');
  var menuBtn = document.getElementById('menuBtn');
  var sceneMenu = document.getElementById('sceneMenu');

  var cur = 0;              // 当前场景索引
  var queue = [];           // 当前场景播放队列
  var qi = 0;               // 队列位置
  var playing = false;
  var audio = new Audio();
  var elMap = {};           // elementId -> DOM
  var spotEl = null;

  /* ---------- 舞台缩放 ---------- */
  function fitStage() {
    var wrap = document.getElementById('stageWrap');
    var s = Math.min(wrap.clientWidth / 1010, wrap.clientHeight / 572.5);
    stage.style.transform = 'scale(' + Math.max(s, 0.1) + ')';
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', fitStage);
  function checkRotate() {
    var tip = document.getElementById('rotateTip');
    if (window.innerWidth < 600 && window.innerHeight > window.innerWidth) tip.classList.add('show');
    else tip.classList.remove('show');
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', checkRotate);
  window.addEventListener('load', checkRotate);
  checkRotate();

  /* ---------- 元素渲染 ---------- */
  function renderText(el) {
    var d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'el text';
    d.style.cssText = 'left:' + el.left + 'px;top:' + el.top + 'px;width:' + el.width + 'px;min-height:' + el.height + 'px;';
    if (el.opacity != null) d.style.opacity = el.opacity;
    d.innerHTML = el.content || '';
    return d;
  }
  function renderShape(el) {
    var d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'el';
    d.style.cssText = 'left:' + el.left + 'px;top:' + el.top + 'px;width:' + el.width + 'px;height:' + el.height + 'px;';
    if (el.opacity != null) d.style.opacity = el.opacity;
    var vb = el.viewBox || [1, 1];
    d.innerHTML = '<svg width="100%" height="100%" viewBox="0 0 ' + vb[0] + ' ' + vb[1] + '" preserveAspectRatio="none">' +
      '<path d="' + el.path + '" fill="' + (el.fill || 'transparent') + '"/></svg>';
    return d;
  }
  function renderLine(el) {
    var x1 = el.start[0], y1 = el.start[1], x2 = el.end[0], y2 = el.end[1];
    var w = Math.max(Math.abs(x2 - x1), 2), h = Math.max(Math.abs(y2 - y1), 2);
    var d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'el';
    d.style.cssText = 'left:' + el.left + 'px;top:' + el.top + 'px;width:' + w + 'px;height:' + h + 'px;';
    if (el.opacity != null) d.style.opacity = el.opacity;
    var dash = el.style === 'dash' ? ' stroke-dasharray="6 4"' : '';
    d.innerHTML = '<svg width="100%" height="100%" viewBox="0 0 ' + w + ' ' + h + '">' +
      '<line x1="' + (x2 >= x1 ? 0 : w) + '" y1="' + (y2 >= y1 ? 0 : h) + '" x2="' + (x2 >= x1 ? w : 0) + '" y2="' + (y2 >= y1 ? h : 0) +
      '" stroke="' + (el.color || '#000') + '" stroke-width="' + (el.width || 1) + '"' + dash + '/></svg>';
    return d;
  }
  function renderImage(el) {
    var d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'el';
    d.style.cssText = 'left:' + el.left + 'px;top:' + el.top + 'px;width:' + el.width + 'px;height:' + el.height + 'px;';
    if (el.opacity != null) d.style.opacity = el.opacity;
    var img = document.createElement('img');
    img.src = (window.ASSET_IMG && ASSET_IMG[el.src]) || el.src; img.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;';
    d.appendChild(img);
    return d;
  }
  function renderTable(el) {
    var d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'el';
    d.style.cssText = 'left:' + el.left + 'px;top:' + el.top + 'px;width:' + el.width + 'px;height:' + el.height + 'px;';
    if (el.opacity != null) d.style.opacity = el.opacity;
    var t = document.createElement('table');
    t.className = 'maic';
    var cg = document.createElement('colgroup');
    (el.colWidths || []).forEach(function (f) {
      var c = document.createElement('col'); c.style.width = (f * 100) + '%'; cg.appendChild(c);
    });
    t.appendChild(cg);
    el.data.forEach(function (row, ri) {
      var tr = document.createElement('tr');
      row.forEach(function (cell) {
        var td = document.createElement(ri === 0 ? 'th' : 'td');
        td.textContent = cell.text || '';
        var st = cell.style || '';
        if (st.indexOf('bold') >= 0) td.style.fontWeight = '700';
        var m = st.match(/backcolor:(#[0-9a-fA-F]+)/); if (m) td.style.background = m[1];
        m = st.match(/align:(center|right)/); if (m) td.style.textAlign = m[1];
        m = st.match(/(?:^|,)color:(#[0-9a-fA-F]+)/); if (m) td.style.color = m[1];
        if (cell.colspan > 1) td.colSpan = cell.colspan;
        if (cell.rowspan > 1) td.rowSpan = cell.rowspan;
        tr.appendChild(td);
      });
      t.appendChild(tr);
    });
    d.appendChild(t);
    return d;
  }
  var RENDERERS = { text: renderText, shape: renderShape, line: renderLine, image: renderImage, table: renderTable };

  function renderSlide(scene) {
    var cv = scene.canvas;
    if (cv.background) {
      if (cv.background.type === 'image' && cv.background.image) {
        var im = document.createElement('img');
        im.className = 'bgimg'; im.src = (window.ASSET_IMG && ASSET_IMG[cv.background.image.src]) || cv.background.image.src; stage.appendChild(im);
      } else if (cv.background.type === 'solid') {
        var sd = document.createElement('div');
        sd.className = 'bgsolid'; sd.style.background = cv.background.color || '#fff'; stage.appendChild(sd);
      }
    }
    (cv.elements || []).forEach(function (el) {
      var fn = RENDERERS[el.type];
      if (!fn) return;
      var node = fn(el);
      if (el.id) { node.dataset.elId = el.id; elMap[el.id] = node; }
      stage.appendChild(node);
    });
  }

  /* ---------- Quiz ---------- */
  var quizState = null;
  function renderQuiz(scene) {
    var box = document.createElement('div');
    box.id = 'quizBox';
    stage.appendChild(box);
    quizState = { i: 0, score: 0, answered: false, qs: scene.questions };
    drawQuestion(box);
  }
  function drawQuestion(box) {
    var st = quizState, q = st.qs[st.i];
    box.innerHTML =
      '<div class="qhead"><h3>随堂 Quiz · 四大名香知多少</h3><div class="qprog">第 ' + (st.i + 1) + ' / ' + st.qs.length + ' 题</div></div>' +
      '<div class="question">' + q.question + '</div>' +
      q.options.map(function (o) {
        return '<div class="opt" data-v="' + o.value + '"><span class="lab">' + o.value + '</span><span>' + o.label + '</span></div>';
      }).join('') +
      '<div class="analysis" id="ana"><b>解析</b><br>' + (q.analysis || '') + '</div>' +
      '<div class="qfoot"><div class="score">当前得分：' + st.score + '</div>' +
      '<button class="goldbtn" id="qNext" disabled>' + (st.i + 1 === st.qs.length ? '查看成绩' : '下一题') + '</button></div>';
    st.answered = false;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(box.querySelectorAll('.opt'), function (opt) {
      opt.addEventListener('click', function () {
        if (st.answered) return;
        st.answered = true;
        var v = opt.dataset.v, ok = q.answer.indexOf(v) >= 0;
        if (ok) { opt.classList.add('correct'); st.score += (q.points || 10); }
        else {
          opt.classList.add('wrong');
          Array.prototype.forEach.call(box.querySelectorAll('.opt'), function (o2) {
            if (q.answer.indexOf(o2.dataset.v) >= 0) o2.classList.add('correct');
          });
        }
        box.querySelector('#ana').classList.add('show');
        box.querySelector('.score').textContent = '当前得分：' + st.score;
        box.querySelector('#qNext').disabled = false;
      });
    });
    box.querySelector('#qNext').addEventListener('click', function () {
      st.i++;
      if (st.i < st.qs.length) drawQuestion(box);
      else {
        box.innerHTML = '<div id="quizResult" style="display:block"><div class="big">' + st.score + ' 分</div>' +
          '<div class="txt">共 ' + st.qs.length + ' 题，满分 ' + st.qs.reduce(function (s, q) { return s + (q.points || 10); }, 0) + ' 分<br>' +
          (st.score >= 40 ? '恭喜，四大名香已经装进心里了。' : '不妨回到课件再翻一翻，香会记得再来的人。') + '</div></div>';
      }
    });
  }

  /* ---------- 场景切换 ---------- */
  function stopPlayback() {
    playing = false;
    audio.pause();
    playBtn.textContent = '▶';
  }
  function showScene(idx) {
    stopPlayback();
    cur = Math.max(0, Math.min(idx, DATA.scenes.length - 1));
    var scene = DATA.scenes[cur];
    stage.innerHTML = '';
    elMap = {};
    if (spotEl) { spotEl.classList.remove('spotlight'); spotEl = null; }
    subtitle.textContent = '';
    sceneTitle.textContent = (scene.order) + ' / ' + DATA.scenes.length + '　' + scene.title;
    if (scene.type === 'slide') renderSlide(scene);
    else if (scene.type === 'pbl' && scene.canvas) renderSlide(scene);
    else if (scene.type === 'interactive') {
      var f = document.createElement('iframe');
      if (window.SCENE_HTML && window.SCENE_HTML[scene.htmlFile]) { f.srcdoc = window.SCENE_HTML[scene.htmlFile]; } else if (window.SCENE7_HTML) { f.srcdoc = window.SCENE7_HTML; } else { f.src = scene.htmlFile; } stage.appendChild(f);
    }
    else if (scene.type === 'quiz') renderQuiz(scene);
    queue = scene.actions || [];
    qi = 0;
    var total = queue.filter(function (a) { return a.type === 'speech'; }).length;
    speechProg.textContent = total ? ('共 ' + total + ' 段讲解') : '';
    prevBtn.disabled = cur === 0;
    nextBtn.disabled = cur === DATA.scenes.length - 1;
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(sceneMenu.children, function (c, i) {
      c.classList.toggle('active', i === cur);
    });
    sceneMenu.classList.remove('open');
  }

  /* ---------- 播放引擎 ---------- */
  function playNext() {
    if (!playing) return;
    if (qi >= queue.length) { stopPlayback(); speechProg.textContent = '本页讲解完毕'; return; }
    var a = queue[qi++];
    if (a.type === 'spotlight') {
      if (spotEl) spotEl.classList.remove('spotlight');
      spotEl = elMap[a.elementId] || null;
      if (spotEl) spotEl.classList.add('spotlight');
      playNext();
      return;
    }
    if (a.type === 'speech') {
      subtitle.textContent = a.text || '';
      var done = queue.slice(0, qi).filter(function (x) { return x.type === 'speech'; }).length;
      var total = queue.filter(function (x) { return x.type === 'speech'; }).length;
      speechProg.textContent = '讲解 ' + done + ' / ' + total;
      if (a.audioId) {
        audio.src = (window.ASSET_AUDIO && ASSET_AUDIO[a.audioId]) || ('assets/audio/' + a.audioId + '.mp3');
        audio.play().catch(function () { setTimeout(playNext, 800); });
      } else {
        setTimeout(playNext, 2500);
      }
      return;
    }
    playNext();
  }
  audio.addEventListener('ended', function () { if (playing) playNext(); });
  playBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (playing) { stopPlayback(); }
    else {
      if (qi >= queue.length) { qi = 0; if (spotEl) { spotEl.classList.remove('spotlight'); spotEl = null; } }
      playing = true; playBtn.textContent = '❚❚';
      if (audio.src && audio.paused && audio.currentTime > 0 && qi > 0) { audio.play().catch(function(){}); }
      else playNext();
    }
  });

  /* ---------- 导航 ---------- */
  prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { showScene(cur - 1); });
  nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { showScene(cur + 1); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (document.getElementById('cover').style.display !== 'none') return;
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') showScene(cur - 1);
    else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') showScene(cur + 1);
    else if (e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); playBtn.click(); }
  });
  DATA.scenes.forEach(function (s, i) {
    var d = document.createElement('div');
    d.className = 'item';
    d.innerHTML = '<span class="no">' + s.order + '</span><span>' + s.title + '</span>';
    d.addEventListener('click', function () { showScene(i); });
    sceneMenu.appendChild(d);
  });
  menuBtn.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); sceneMenu.classList.toggle('open'); });
  document.addEventListener('click', function () { sceneMenu.classList.remove('open'); });

  document.getElementById('startBtn').addEventListener('click', function () {
    document.getElementById('cover').style.display = 'none';
    fitStage();
    showScene(0);
  });
  fitStage();
})();
</script>







<!-- ===== 沉浸横屏 v2 + 古筝 BGM（2026-09-12 重写，两文件同步）===== -->

  #fsBtn, #bgmBtn { padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 14px; }

  body.immersive #topbar, body.immersive #bottombar { display: none; }
  body.immersive #stageWrap { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 70; background: #0d0a08; cursor: pointer; }
  body.immersive #rotateTip { display: none !important; }
  /* 沉浸态悬浮控件：视频播放器式，自动隐藏、点屏唤出 */
  #fsTop, #fsBottom {
    position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 82; display: none; align-items: center;
    gap: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; opacity: 1; transition: opacity .25s; cursor: pointer;
  }
  body.immersive #fsTop, body.immersive #fsBottom { display: flex; }
  #fsTop { top: 0; background: linear-gradient(rgba(13,10,8,.88), rgba(13,10,8,0)); padding-top: max(10px, env(safe-area-inset-top)); }
  #fsBottom { bottom: 0; background: linear-gradient(rgba(13,10,8,0), rgba(13,10,8,.88)); padding-bottom: max(18px, calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 12px)); }
  body.immersive.uiHidden #fsTop, body.immersive.uiHidden #fsBottom { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
  #fsTitle {
    font-size: 13px; color: #e8dcc8; letter-spacing: 1px; overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-family: 'Songti SC','STSong',serif;
  }
  .fsSpacer { flex: 1; }
  .fsBtn {
    background: rgba(42,35,32,.72); border: 1px solid #4a3d30; color: #e8dcc8;
    border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 14px; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px); backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    -webkit-user-select: none; user-select: none; -webkit-touch-callout: none;
  }
  .fsBtn:active { border-color: #d4af37; }
  .fsBtn:disabled { opacity: .3; }
  .fsBtn.play {
    width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 50%; border-color: #d4af37;
    color: #d4af37; font-size: 15px; padding: 0; flex: none;
  }
  #fsBgm.on { color: #d4af37; border-color: rgba(212,175,55,.65); }
  #fsProg { font-size: 12px; color: #a3937d; }
  #fsSub {
    position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 66px; z-index: 81; display: none;
    text-align: center; padding: 6px 18px; font-size: 15px; color: #f3ead8;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.9); line-height: 1.6; pointer-events: none;
  }
  body.immersive #fsSub:empty { display: none; }
  body.immersive #fsSub { display: block; }
  #pwaHint {
    position: fixed; top: calc(max(10px, env(safe-area-inset-top)) + 46px); left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 90; display: none; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    background: rgba(20,15,12,.9); border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,.5); color: #e8dcc8;
    font-size: 12.5px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 10px; max-width: 86vw; line-height: 1.5;
  }
  #pwaHint.show { display: flex; }
  #pwaHint button {
    flex: none; background: none; border: 1px solid #4a3d30; color: #d4af37;
    border-radius: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer;
  }
</style>
<div id="pwaHint">
  <span>想隐藏 Safari 浏览器栏获得真全屏：点底部分享 →「添加到主屏幕」，从主屏图标进入</span>
  <button id="pwaHintOk">知道了</button>
</div>
<div id="fsTop">
  <span id="fsTitle"></span>
  <span class="fsSpacer"></span>
  <button class="fsBtn on" id="fsBgm" title="背景音乐开关">🎼</button>
  <button class="fsBtn" id="fsExit" title="退出全屏">✕</button>
</div>
<div id="fsSub"></div>
<div id="fsBottom">
  <button class="fsBtn nav" id="fsPrev">‹ 上一页</button>
  <button class="fsBtn play" id="fsPlay" title="播放/暂停">▶</button>
  <button class="fsBtn nav" id="fsNext">下一页 ›</button>
  <span id="fsProg"></span>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  /* ================= 一、沉浸横屏（悬浮控件 + 自动隐藏） ================= */
  var menuBtn = document.getElementById('menuBtn');
  if (menuBtn) {
    menuBtn.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin',
      '<button class="navbtn" id="bgmBtn" title="背景音乐开关">🎼</button>' +
      '<button class="navbtn" id="fsBtn" title="全屏 / 退出全屏">⛶</button>');
  }
  var fsBtn = document.getElementById('fsBtn');
  var stageWrap = document.getElementById('stageWrap');
  var stageEl = document.getElementById('stage');
  var fsTop = document.getElementById('fsTop');
  var fsBottom = document.getElementById('fsBottom');
  var imManual = false, imAuto = false, pinned = false, hideTimer = null, imSuppress = false;

  function refit() { setTimeout(function () { window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize')); }, 60); }
  function isImmersive() { return document.body.classList.contains('immersive'); }
  function uiHidden() { return document.body.classList.contains('uiHidden'); }

  function showUI() {
    document.body.classList.remove('uiHidden');
    clearTimeout(hideTimer);
    if (!pinned) hideTimer = setTimeout(function () { document.body.classList.add('uiHidden'); }, 3200);
  }
  function enterIm(manual) {
    if (isImmersive()) return;
    document.body.classList.add('immersive');
    if (manual) imManual = true; else imAuto = true;
    try {
      var el = document.documentElement;
      var rfs = el.requestFullscreen || el.webkitRequestFullscreen;   // Safari 旧版需 webkit 前缀
      if (rfs) {
        var p = rfs.call(el, { navigationUI: 'hide' });
        if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function () {});
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    showUI();
    refit();
    maybeShowPwaHint();
  }
  function exitIm() {
    imManual = false; imAuto = false;
    imSuppress = true;   // 手动退出后抑制自动重进（refit 的 resize 会触发 checkOri），直到真实转屏
    clearTimeout(hideTimer);
    document.body.classList.remove('immersive');
    document.body.classList.remove('uiHidden');
    try {
      var fsEl = document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement;
      if (fsEl) (document.exitFullscreen || document.webkitExitFullscreen).call(document);
    } catch (e) {}
    refit();
  }
  if (fsBtn) fsBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { isImmersive() ? exitIm() : enterIm(true); });
  document.getElementById('fsExit').addEventListener('click', exitIm);
  var onFsChange = function () {
    if (!(document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement) && isImmersive()) {
      imManual = false; imAuto = false;
      document.body.classList.remove('immersive');
      document.body.classList.remove('uiHidden');
      refit();
    }
  };
  document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', onFsChange);
  document.addEventListener('webkitfullscreenchange', onFsChange);
  // 点课件区域：隐藏则唤出，唤出则隐藏（悬浮条上的点击不触发——它们不是 stageWrap 子元素）
  // iOS WebKit 对无 cursor/无触摸监听的普通 div 不派发 click，必须显式监听 touchend
  var lastTouchToggle = 0, tSX = 0, tSY = 0;
  function toggleUI() {
    if (!isImmersive()) return;
    if (uiHidden()) showUI();
    else { clearTimeout(hideTimer); document.body.classList.add('uiHidden'); }
  }
  stageWrap.addEventListener('touchstart', function (e) {
    var t = e.changedTouches[0]; tSX = t.clientX; tSY = t.clientY;
  }, { passive: true });
  stageWrap.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
    if (!isImmersive()) return;
    var t = e.changedTouches[0];
    if (Math.abs(t.clientX - tSX) > 12 || Math.abs(t.clientY - tSY) > 12) return;   // 滑动/滚动不算点按
    lastTouchToggle = Date.now();
    e.preventDefault();   // 阻止 iOS 再合成一次 click 造成双重切换
    toggleUI();
  }, { passive: false });
  stageWrap.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (Date.now() - lastTouchToggle < 600) return;   // touchend 已处理
    toggleUI();
  });
  // 悬浮条任何点击都重置自动隐藏计时
  [fsTop, fsBottom].forEach(function (bar) {
    bar.addEventListener('click', function () { showUI(); });
  });
  // 交互场景（iframe：辨香台） taps 传不到外层，悬浮条必须常驻
  new MutationObserver(function () {
    pinned = !!stageEl.querySelector('iframe');
    if (pinned) { clearTimeout(hideTimer); document.body.classList.remove('uiHidden'); }
    else if (isImmersive()) showUI();
  }).observe(stageEl, { childList: true });
  // 手机横放自动进入，竖回自动退出（仅自动进入的才自动退出）
  function isPhone() {
    return window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches &&
      Math.min(window.screen.width, window.screen.height) < 840;
  }
  var oriTimer = null;
  function checkOri() {
    clearTimeout(oriTimer);
    oriTimer = setTimeout(function () {
      if (!isPhone()) return;
      var land = window.innerWidth > window.innerHeight;
      if (!land) imSuppress = false;   // 转回竖屏后解除抑制，下次横放可再自动进入
      if (land && !isImmersive() && !imSuppress) enterIm(false);
      else if (!land && imAuto && !imManual) exitIm();
    }, 200);
  }
  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () { imSuppress = false; checkOri(); });
  window.addEventListener('resize', checkOri);
  // 直开即为横屏时也自动进入（开始课后触发一次检查）
  var startBtnEl = document.getElementById('startBtn');
  if (startBtnEl) startBtnEl.addEventListener('click', function () { setTimeout(checkOri, 400); });

  /* ---------- 悬浮控件镜像主引擎状态（不动原引擎代码） ---------- */
  var pb = document.getElementById('playBtn');
  var prevB = document.getElementById('prevBtn');
  var nextB = document.getElementById('nextBtn');
  var fsPlay = document.getElementById('fsPlay');
  var fsPrev = document.getElementById('fsPrev');
  var fsNext = document.getElementById('fsNext');
  fsPlay.addEventListener('click', function () { pb.click(); });
  fsPrev.addEventListener('click', function () { prevB.click(); });
  fsNext.addEventListener('click', function () { nextB.click(); });
  // iOS 主屏（PWA）模式下按钮 click 合成不稳定：所有悬浮按钮加 touchend 直通，
  // preventDefault 抑制后续 click 合成，等效于只触发一次
  [fsPlay, fsPrev, fsNext,
   document.getElementById('fsBgm'), document.getElementById('fsExit'),
   document.getElementById('pwaHintOk')].forEach(function (b) {
    if (!b) return;
    b.addEventListener('touchend', function (e) {
      if (b.disabled) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      b.click();
    }, { passive: false });
  });
  new MutationObserver(function () { fsPlay.textContent = pb.textContent; })
    .observe(pb, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });
  new MutationObserver(function () {
    fsPrev.disabled = prevB.disabled;
    fsNext.disabled = nextB.disabled;
  }).observe(prevB, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['disabled'] });
  new MutationObserver(function () {
    fsPrev.disabled = prevB.disabled;
    fsNext.disabled = nextB.disabled;
  }).observe(nextB, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['disabled'] });
  var sub = document.getElementById('subtitle');
  var fsSub = document.getElementById('fsSub');
  new MutationObserver(function () { fsSub.textContent = sub.textContent; })
    .observe(sub, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });
  var prog = document.getElementById('speechProg');
  var fsProg = document.getElementById('fsProg');
  new MutationObserver(function () { fsProg.textContent = prog.textContent; })
    .observe(prog, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });
  var title = document.getElementById('sceneTitle');
  var fsTitle = document.getElementById('fsTitle');
  new MutationObserver(function () { fsTitle.textContent = title.textContent; })
    .observe(title, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });

  /* ================= 二、古筝背景音乐（skills 生成的真实古筝曲，无缝循环） ================= */
  var BGM_SRC = (window.ASSET_AUDIO && window.ASSET_AUDIO['bgm-guzheng']) || 'assets/audio/bgm-guzheng.m4a';
  var bgmOn = true, bgmStarted = false, actx = null, master = null, bgmEl = null, ducked = false;
  var bgmBtn = document.getElementById('bgmBtn');
  var fsBgm = document.getElementById('fsBgm');

  function setBgmLevel() {
    if (!master || !actx) return;
    var target = !bgmOn ? 0 : (ducked ? 0.16 : 0.55);
    master.gain.setTargetAtTime(target, actx.currentTime, 0.5);
  }
  function syncBgmBtns() {
    if (bgmBtn) bgmBtn.classList.toggle('off', !bgmOn);
    if (fsBgm) fsBgm.classList.toggle('on', bgmOn);
  }
  function initBgm() {
    if (bgmStarted) {
      if (actx && actx.state === 'suspended') actx.resume();
      if (bgmEl && bgmEl.paused) bgmEl.play().catch(function () {});
      return;
    }
    bgmStarted = true;
    try {
      var AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
      actx = new AC();
      bgmEl = new Audio();
      bgmEl.loop = true;
      bgmEl.src = BGM_SRC;
      var node = actx.createMediaElementSource(bgmEl);
      master = actx.createGain();
      node.connect(master);
      master.connect(actx.destination);
      setBgmLevel();
      bgmEl.play().catch(function () {});
      // 讲课时压低音乐：语音 Audio 对象未挂 DOM 监听不到事件，改为观察播放键文字（❚❚=播放中）
      var syncDuck = function () {
        ducked = pb.textContent.indexOf('❚') !== -1;
        setBgmLevel();
      };
      new MutationObserver(syncDuck).observe(pb, { childList: true, characterData: true, subtree: true });
      syncDuck();
      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function () {
        if (!document.hidden && actx.state === 'suspended') actx.resume();
      });
    } catch (e) { window.__bgmErr = String((e && e.stack) || e); }
  }
  function toggleBgm() {
    bgmOn = !bgmOn;
    syncBgmBtns();
    if (bgmOn) initBgm();
    setBgmLevel();
  }
  var startBtn = document.getElementById('startBtn');
  if (startBtn) startBtn.addEventListener('click', initBgm);
  if (bgmBtn) bgmBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleBgm);
  if (fsBgm) fsBgm.addEventListener('click', toggleBgm);
  syncBgmBtns();

  /* ---------- iOS 真全屏指引（iPhone/iPad Safari 无法编程隐藏浏览器栏） ---------- */
  var ua = navigator.userAgent || '';
  var isIOS = /iP(hone|ad|od)/.test(ua);
  var inWeChat = /MicroMessenger/i.test(ua);
  var standalone = navigator.standalone === true ||
    (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches);
  var pwaHint = document.getElementById('pwaHint');
  function maybeShowPwaHint() {
    if (!pwaHint || !isIOS || inWeChat || standalone) return;
    try { if (localStorage.getItem('maic:pwaHintOk')) return; } catch (e) {}
    pwaHint.classList.add('show');
    setTimeout(function () { pwaHint.classList.remove('show'); }, 12000);
  }
  if (pwaHint) {
    document.getElementById('pwaHintOk').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      pwaHint.classList.remove('show');
      try { localStorage.setItem('maic:pwaHintOk', '1'); } catch (err) {}
    });
    pwaHint.addEventListener('click', function (e) { e.stopPropagation(); });
  }

  // 调试钩子（自动化验收用）
  window.__immersive = { enter: enterIm, exit: exitIm, isOn: isImmersive, uiHidden: uiHidden };
  window.__bgm = {
    get ctx() { return actx; },
    get gain() { return master ? master.gain.value : null; },
    get on() { return bgmOn; },
    get el() { return bgmEl; }
  };
})();
</script>


</body>
</html>
